description: This file defines the internal class 'SiloStatusListenerManager' which manages 'ISiloStatusListener' instances, allowing subscription, unsubscription, and notification of status changes within the Orleans runtime membership service.

classes.name: SiloStatusListenerManager
classes.description: Manages silo status listeners, supporting subscription, unsubscription, and notifying listeners of status changes within the Orleans cluster.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Adds a listener to the manager if it is not already subscribed.

methods.name: Unsubscribe
methods.description: Removes a listener from the manager if it exists.

methods.name: ProcessMembershipUpdates
methods.description: Async method that processes membership updates, creating snapshots and notifying observers.

methods.name: NotifyObservers
methods.description: Notifies all subscribed listeners of status changes based on the provided cluster membership update.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Implements the ILifecycleParticipant interface to integrate with the silo lifecycle, starting and stopping membership update processing.

methods.name: LogDebugStartingToProcessMembershipUpdates
methods.description: Logs the start of membership update processing.

methods.name: LogErrorProcessingMembershipUpdates
methods.description: Logs errors encountered during processing of membership updates.

methods.name: LogDebugStoppingMembershipUpdateProcessor
methods.description: Logs the stopping of membership update processor.

methods.name: LogErrorCallingSiloStatusChangeNotification
methods.description: Logs errors thrown when notifying a listener of a silo status change.
